records.description: Vantage Data Centers develops, owns, manages and operates hyperscale data-center campuses for cloud, AI, internet and large-enterprise customers. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Denver, the global platform includes substantial United States and Canadian operations. This canonical record consolidates direct platform equity and manager-level North American co-investments while treating Vantage SDC as a stabilized 12-asset North American portfolio managed and operated by Vantage rather than as a separate company. DigitalBridge has held platform equity since the March 2017 acquisition and led the closed $9.2 billion 2024 recapitalization with Silver Lake. CBRE participated first in pre-SDC platform equity and then in the current Vantage SDC portfolio; DigitalBridge separately retains a 12.8% SDC interest. Pantheon Infrastructure plc has a current $34.7 million North American co-investment, GCM Grosvenor retains its disclosed growth-platform exposure, and PSP exited the North American and EMEA development platforms in 2024 while disclosing a residual Vantage interest. Exact post-2024 platform percentages, most vehicles, CBRE's SDC percentage, Pantheon's closing date and PSP's residual layer are not publicly disclosed. No signed Vantage sale or later ownership transfer was identified through August 23, 2026.
